# Background

Somatic mutation frequency in COSMIC is used elsewhere in this project as a
predictor of pathogenicity for missense variants in dominant developmental
disorder genes. This rests on the assumption that COSMIC's variant calls are
genuinely somatic. In practice, not every tumour sample deposited in COSMIC
was sequenced alongside matched germline (normal-tissue) material. Where
matched-normal sequencing was not performed, COSMIC still records the
variant, but labels it **"Variant of unknown origin"** rather than
**"Confirmed somatic variant"** (COSMIC's own terminology). A variant of
unknown origin could in principle be an unrecognised germline variant
present in the tumour rather than a true somatic event.

This analysis quantifies, for every dominant DDG2P gene with sufficient
ClinVar and population data to be benchmarked elsewhere in this project, the
proportion of COSMIC's own depositions of the *exact* variants used as
pathogenic and benign evidence that carry matched-normal confirmation.
Restricting the check to the exact variants used as evidence — rather than
any COSMIC variant occurring in the same gene, or at the same codon —
directly addresses how much of the specific evidence relied on could be
germline contamination, rather than a broader statement about mutation
recurrence in these genes.

Variants are matched between COSMIC and the reference variant sets by
genomic coordinate and allele identity (chromosome, position, reference
allele, mutant allele) on the GRCh38 assembly, rather than by transcript and
codon number. Genomic coordinates and alleles are a property of the
reference assembly rather than of any one transcript model, so this
avoids the need to reconcile differing transcript annotations between
independently generated variant call sets.

# Data sources

| Input | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| COSMIC targeted-screen mutation export | `Data/Cancer_data/Cosmic_CompleteTargetedScreensMutant_Tsv_v101_GRCh38.tar` | One row per variant per tumour sample from targeted gene-panel studies (COSMIC v101, GRCh38). Includes both positive and negative screening results (`POSITIVE_SCREEN`), flagged per row. |
| COSMIC genome-screen mutation export | `Data/Cancer_data/Cosmic_GenomeScreensMutant_Tsv_v101_GRCh38.tar` | Same granularity, from whole-genome/exome studies. Contains positive screening results only. |
| ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants | `Data/Variant_lists/Clinvar_DDG2P_missense_path_annot_260526_public.tsv.gz` | Missense ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic calls for dominant DDG2P genes, with genomic coordinates (GRCh38). |
| UK Biobank benign variants | `Data/Variant_lists/Biobank_missense_variants_annot_260526_public.tsv.gz` | Population-frequency-filtered benign-germline missense calls, same schema. |
| Gene benchmarking status | `Data/AUC_tables/Gene_group_hold_out_models/Single_feature_AUCs_individual_genes_240426.csv`, `Data/AUC_tables/Gene_group_hold_out_models/Variant_counts_per_gene_240426.csv`, `Data/ML_model_input/gene_heterogeneity_feature_matrix.csv` | Per-gene AUC and variant counts defining benchmarking eligibility and the "positive"/"negative"/"grey" somatic-utility labels (monoallelic DD genes only). |
| Somatic-informative gene set | `Data/Tables/Supplementary_Table2.csv` | Defines the 145 genes for which somatic data are informative (any inheritance pattern), the primary gene set reported by this check. |

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
theme_set(theme_bw(12))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, cache = TRUE, autodep = TRUE)

DATA_DIR     <- "../../../Data"
GENOME_TAR   <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Cancer_data/Cosmic_GenomeScreensMutant_Tsv_v101_GRCh38.tar")
TARGETED_TAR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Cancer_data/Cosmic_CompleteTargetedScreensMutant_Tsv_v101_GRCh38.tar")
PATH_FILE    <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Variant_lists/Clinvar_DDG2P_missense_path_annot_260526_public.tsv.gz")
BENIGN_FILE  <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Variant_lists/Biobank_missense_variants_annot_260526_public.tsv.gz")
AUC_FILE     <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "AUC_tables/Gene_group_hold_out_models/Single_feature_AUCs_individual_genes_240426.csv")
VC_FILE      <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "AUC_tables/Gene_group_hold_out_models/Variant_counts_per_gene_240426.csv")
FEAT_FILE    <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "ML_model_input/gene_heterogeneity_feature_matrix.csv")

OUT_OVERALL     <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "ML_model_input/cosmic_germline_contamination_overall.csv")
OUT_OVERALL_POS <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "ML_model_input/cosmic_germline_contamination_overall_positive_only.csv")
OUT_OVERALL_145 <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "ML_model_input/cosmic_germline_contamination_overall_145_informative.csv")
OUT_PER_GENE    <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "ML_model_input/cosmic_germline_contamination_per_gene.csv")
OUT_PER_GENE_145 <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "ML_model_input/cosmic_germline_contamination_per_gene_145_informative.csv")
OUT_SUPP_TABLE  <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "ML_model_input/cosmic_germline_contamination_supplementary_table.csv")
OUT_FIG         <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Figures/Final/Supplement/COSMIC_germline_contamination_check.png")

for (f in c(GENOME_TAR, TARGETED_TAR, PATH_FILE, BENIGN_FILE, AUC_FILE, VC_FILE, FEAT_FILE,
            file.path(DATA_DIR, "Tables/Supplementary_Table2.csv")))
  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Required input not found: ", f)
```

# 1. Gene set

Analysis is restricted to dominant (monoallelic) DDG2P genes that are
**benchmarking-eligible**: at least 10 unique ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely
Pathogenic missense variants and at least 10 unique UK Biobank
benign-germline missense variants. This is the same eligibility criterion
used to define somatic-utility labels elsewhere in this project, applied
here directly from its source tables. Each eligible gene carries its
"positive" (COSMIC-codon-count AUC lower 95% CI > 0.70), "negative" (upper
95% CI < 0.60), or "grey" (neither) somatic-utility label as an annotation;
every eligible gene is otherwise treated identically throughout.

The primary gene set reported by this check (Section 5.2b, Discussion) is
broader than this monoallelic set: the 145 genes for which somatic data are
informative (Supplementary Table 2; AUC lower 95% CI > 0.6 for at least one
of COSMIC, sperm, or buccal missense codon count, count-weighted ClinVar
form), which includes 48 genes with a biallelic or X-linked hemizygous
inheritance pattern not covered by the monoallelic set above. COSMIC
matching (Section 3) is run once, across the union of both gene sets.

```{r genes}
auc <- read_csv(AUC_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(Predictor == "n_COSMIC_codon_count", dataset == "clinvar_long") %>%
  transmute(gene = trimws(gene), auc_lower = AUC_full_lower)
vc <- read_csv(VC_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(data_set == "clinvar_mutation_data_unique") %>%
  transmute(gene = trimws(gene), n_path_unique = n_path_variants, n_benign_unique = n_benign_variants)
feat <- read_csv(FEAT_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

gene_universe <- feat %>% select(gene, label) %>%
  left_join(auc, by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(vc, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(eligible = !is.na(auc_lower) & !is.na(n_path_unique) & !is.na(n_benign_unique) &
           n_path_unique >= 10 & n_benign_unique >= 10)

genes_eligible <- gene_universe %>% filter(eligible) %>% pull(gene)
genes_positive <- gene_universe %>% filter(eligible, label == "positive") %>% pull(gene)
genes_negative <- gene_universe %>% filter(eligible, label == "negative") %>% pull(gene)

cat("Benchmarking-eligible genes:", length(genes_eligible), "\n")
cat("  of which positive (somatic-informative):", length(genes_positive), "\n")
cat("  of which negative (contrast):", length(genes_negative), "\n")
cat("  of which grey:", length(genes_eligible) - length(genes_positive) - length(genes_negative), "\n")

# The 145 genes for which somatic data are informative (Results, "Somatic
# data predicts germline pathogenicity in DD genes"): benchmarking-eligible
# DD genes (>=10 unique pathogenic and >=10 unique benign ClinVar variants,
# any inheritance pattern -- not restricted to monoallelic as `genes_eligible`
# above is) with a count-weighted-ClinVar AUC lower 95% CI > 0.6 for at least
# one of COSMIC, sperm NanoSeq, or buccal NanoSeq missense codon count.
# Reproduced directly from Supplementary Table 2 for consistency.
ST2_FILE <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Tables/Supplementary_Table2.csv")
st2 <- read_csv(ST2_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% filter(dataset == "clinvar_count_weighted")
qualifying_genes <- function(predictor) {
  st2 %>% filter(Predictor == predictor, !is.na(AUC_full_lower), AUC_full_lower > 0.6) %>% pull(gene)
}
genes_145 <- union(union(qualifying_genes("n_COSMIC_codon_count"), qualifying_genes("n_sperm_codon_count")),
                    qualifying_genes("n_buccal_codon_count"))
cat("\nGenes for which somatic data are informative (Supplementary Table 2):", length(genes_145), "\n")
cat("  of which already in the monoallelic benchmarking-eligible set above:",
    length(intersect(genes_145, genes_eligible)), "\n")
cat("  of which not monoallelic-eligible above (biallelic/hemizygous; need separate COSMIC matching):",
    length(setdiff(genes_145, genes_eligible)), "\n")

# Union of genes to scan COSMIC for: the monoallelic benchmarking-eligible
# set already needed for genes_eligible/genes_positive/genes_negative above,
# plus the (typically biallelic/hemizygous) genes in genes_145 not already
# covered by that set. Everything downstream that filters on genes_eligible
# or genes_positive is unaffected; a new section below reports genes_145.
genes_scan_all <- union(genes_eligible, genes_145)
cat("Total genes to scan COSMIC for:", length(genes_scan_all), "\n")
```

# 2. Reference variant sets

ClinVar pathogenic and UK Biobank benign variants are represented by their
genomic coordinates and alleles (chromosome, position, reference allele,
mutant allele; GRCh38), restricted to benchmarking-eligible genes. COSMIC's
own chromosome field omits the `chr` prefix used in the reference files, so
the prefix is stripped for consistency.

```{r lookup}
path_lookup <- read_tsv(PATH_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE,
                         col_select = c(gene, chrom, pos, ref, alt)) %>%
  filter(gene %in% genes_scan_all) %>%
  mutate(chrom = str_remove(chrom, "^chr")) %>%
  distinct(gene, chrom, pos, ref, alt)
benign_lookup <- read_tsv(BENIGN_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE,
                           col_select = c(gene, chrom, pos, ref, alt)) %>%
  filter(gene %in% genes_scan_all) %>%
  mutate(chrom = str_remove(chrom, "^chr")) %>%
  distinct(gene, chrom, pos, ref, alt)

cat("Distinct ClinVar P/LP variants:", nrow(path_lookup), "\n")
cat("Distinct biobank-benign variants:", nrow(benign_lookup), "\n")
cat("Scanned genes with zero ClinVar P/LP variants:\n  ",
    paste(setdiff(genes_scan_all, unique(path_lookup$gene)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Scanned genes with zero biobank-benign variants:\n  ",
    paste(setdiff(genes_scan_all, unique(benign_lookup$gene)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 3. COSMIC mutation records and variant matching

Each COSMIC export is streamed directly from its compressed archive without
being written to disk, and filtered in a single pass to rows whose gene
symbol is one of the benchmarking-eligible genes and whose genomic
coordinate and allele exactly match one of the combined ClinVar or
biobank-benign reference variants. The reference variant sets are already
restricted to missense substitutions, so an exact coordinate-and-allele
match to either set guarantees the COSMIC record represents the same
missense substitution, independent of whichever consequence annotation
COSMIC itself assigned to that particular record.

For the targeted-screen export, records are additionally required to have
`POSITIVE_SCREEN == "y"`: this file reports both variants actually observed
in a sample and negative screening results (a gene tested and found
unmutated in that sample), the latter making up the majority of rows and
carrying no variant information. The genome-screen export contains positive
results only.

Both COSMIC exports use CRLF line endings, so the final tab-delimited field
on each row carries a trailing carriage return that is stripped prior to
comparison. Column identities (gene symbol, somatic-status annotation,
chromosome, position, reference and mutant allele, sample identifier, and,
for the targeted-screen file, the screening-result flag) are located by
pattern-matching each file's own header rather than by fixed column index,
so the pipeline is robust to COSMIC schema changes across releases.

Genomic alleles in COSMIC are reported on the forward reference strand
regardless of the annotated gene's own strand. This was verified directly
for a plus-strand gene and a minus-strand gene prior to matching, confirming
that no strand complementation is required when comparing COSMIC alleles to
the reference variant sets.

```{r load-cosmic-helper}
gene_list_file <- tempfile()
write_lines(genes_scan_all, gene_list_file)

variant_key_file <- tempfile()
combined_keys <- unique(c(
  paste(path_lookup$chrom, path_lookup$pos, path_lookup$ref, path_lookup$alt, sep = "_"),
  paste(benign_lookup$chrom, benign_lookup$pos, benign_lookup$ref, benign_lookup$alt, sep = "_")
))
write_lines(combined_keys, variant_key_file)
cat("Combined distinct (chrom,pos,ref,alt) keys to match against:", length(combined_keys), "\n")

load_cosmic_tar <- function(tar_path, screen_type) {
  members <- system(sprintf("tar -tf %s", shQuote(tar_path)), intern = TRUE)
  tsv_member <- members[str_detect(members, "\\.tsv\\.gz$")]
  stopifnot("expected exactly one .tsv.gz member in the tar" = length(tsv_member) == 1)
  stream_cmd <- sprintf("tar -xOf %s %s | gzip -dc", shQuote(tar_path), shQuote(tsv_member))

  header <- read_lines(pipe(stream_cmd), n_max = 1)
  raw_cols <- str_split(str_remove(header, "\r$"), "\t")[[1]]

  gene_col_idx    <- which(str_detect(tolower(raw_cols), "^gene[ _]?(name|symbol)$"))
  status_col_idx  <- which(str_detect(tolower(raw_cols), "somatic") & str_detect(tolower(raw_cols), "status"))
  chr_col_idx     <- which(str_detect(tolower(raw_cols), "^chromosome$"))
  pos_col_idx     <- which(str_detect(tolower(raw_cols), "^genome.?start$"))
  wt_col_idx      <- which(str_detect(tolower(raw_cols), "genomic.*wt.*allele"))
  mut_col_idx     <- which(str_detect(tolower(raw_cols), "genomic.*mut.*allele"))
  sample_col_idx  <- which(str_detect(tolower(raw_cols), "^cosmic.?sample.?id$"))
  ps_col_idx      <- which(str_detect(tolower(raw_cols), "positive.?screen"))

  stopifnot("gene column ambiguous/not found" = length(gene_col_idx) == 1,
            "somatic-status column ambiguous/not found" = length(status_col_idx) == 1,
            "chromosome column ambiguous/not found" = length(chr_col_idx) == 1,
            "genome-start column ambiguous/not found" = length(pos_col_idx) == 1,
            "genomic-WT-allele column ambiguous/not found" = length(wt_col_idx) == 1,
            "genomic-MUT-allele column ambiguous/not found" = length(mut_col_idx) == 1,
            "COSMIC-sample-ID column ambiguous/not found" = length(sample_col_idx) == 1)
  cat(sprintf("[%s] gene=%s status=%s chrom=%s pos=%s wt=%s mut=%s sample=%s positive_screen=%s\n", screen_type,
              raw_cols[gene_col_idx], raw_cols[status_col_idx], raw_cols[chr_col_idx], raw_cols[pos_col_idx],
              raw_cols[wt_col_idx], raw_cols[mut_col_idx], raw_cols[sample_col_idx],
              if (length(ps_col_idx) == 1) raw_cols[ps_col_idx] else "(none - positive results only)"))

  sel_idx <- c(gene_col_idx, status_col_idx, chr_col_idx, pos_col_idx, wt_col_idx, mut_col_idx, sample_col_idx)
  awk_print <- paste(sprintf("$%d", sel_idx), collapse = ", ")
  ps_filter <- if (length(ps_col_idx) == 1) sprintf(" && $%d == \"y\"", ps_col_idx) else ""
  key_expr <- sprintf("$%d\"_\"$%d\"_\"$%d\"_\"$%d", chr_col_idx, pos_col_idx, wt_col_idx, mut_col_idx)

  cmd <- sprintf(
    paste0(
      "%s | awk -F'\\t' -v gcol=%d -v genefile=%s -v variantfile=%s ",
      "'BEGIN{OFS=\"\\t\"; while((getline line < genefile) > 0) genes[line]=1; ",
      "while((getline line < variantfile) > 0) variants[line]=1} ",
      "{sub(/\\r$/,\"\",$NF)} ",
      "NR==1{print %s; next} ",
      "($gcol in genes) && ((%s) in variants)%s {print %s}'"
    ),
    stream_cmd, gene_col_idx, shQuote(gene_list_file), shQuote(variant_key_file),
    awk_print, key_expr, ps_filter, awk_print
  )

  dat <- read_tsv(pipe(cmd), show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
  names(dat) <- c("gene", "somatic_status", "chrom", "pos", "ref", "alt", "cosmic_sample_id")
  dat %>% mutate(screen_type = screen_type, pos = as.integer(pos))
}
```

```{r load-cosmic-targeted}
targeted <- load_cosmic_tar(TARGETED_TAR, "targeted")
cat("Targeted-screen exact-variant matches (pre-deduplication):", nrow(targeted), "\n")
```

```{r load-cosmic-genome}
genome <- load_cosmic_tar(GENOME_TAR, "genome")
cat("Genome-screen exact-variant matches (pre-deduplication):", nrow(genome), "\n")
```

# 4. Deduplication of transcript-redundant records

COSMIC reports a single variant observed in a single tumour sample once for
each transcript the variant is annotated against, so a given
sample-and-variant combination can appear as multiple records in the raw
export. Because matching is performed on genomic coordinate and allele
rather than transcript, each such group of records would otherwise be
counted as multiple independent depositions. Records are therefore
deduplicated to one row per combination of variant and COSMIC sample
identifier prior to any tabulation, so that counts reflect the number of
tumours in which a variant was observed. The somatic-status annotation is
invariant across the duplicate transcript-level records for a given sample
and is retained unchanged.

```{r dedup}
dedup_by_sample <- function(dat, screen_type) {
  n_before <- nrow(dat)
  dat <- dat %>% distinct(chrom, pos, ref, alt, cosmic_sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(-cosmic_sample_id)
  cat(sprintf("[%s] records before deduplication: %d; after: %d\n", screen_type, n_before, nrow(dat)))
  dat
}
targeted <- dedup_by_sample(targeted, "targeted")
genome   <- dedup_by_sample(genome, "genome")
```

# 5. Tabulation

```{r overlap}
cosmic <- bind_rows(targeted, genome)
cat("Combined exact-variant depositions across both COSMIC exports:", nrow(cosmic), "\n")
cat("Distinct somatic-status categories observed:\n")
cosmic %>% count(somatic_status, sort = TRUE) %>% knitr::kable()

path_hits   <- cosmic %>% inner_join(path_lookup,   by = c("gene", "chrom", "pos", "ref", "alt")) %>% mutate(class = "ClinVar P/LP")
benign_hits <- cosmic %>% inner_join(benign_lookup, by = c("gene", "chrom", "pos", "ref", "alt")) %>% mutate(class = "Biobank benign")
overlap <- bind_rows(path_hits, benign_hits)

cat("\nDepositions matching a ClinVar P/LP variant:", nrow(path_hits), "\n")
cat("Depositions matching a biobank-benign variant:", nrow(benign_hits), "\n")
cat("Positive genes with no COSMIC depositions in either class:\n  ",
    paste(setdiff(genes_positive, unique(overlap$gene)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 5.1 All benchmarking-eligible genes

```{r overall}
overall <- overlap %>% count(class, somatic_status) %>%
  group_by(class) %>% mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  arrange(class, desc(n)) %>% ungroup()
overall %>% knitr::kable(caption = sprintf("All %d benchmarking-eligible genes", length(genes_eligible)))
write_csv(overall, OUT_OVERALL)
```

## 5.2 Positive genes only

```{r overall-positive}
overall_pos <- overlap %>% filter(gene %in% genes_positive) %>%
  count(class, somatic_status) %>%
  group_by(class) %>% mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  arrange(class, desc(n)) %>% ungroup()
overall_pos %>% knitr::kable(caption = sprintf("The %d somatic-informative (positive) genes only", length(genes_positive)))
write_csv(overall_pos, OUT_OVERALL_POS)
```

## 5.2b The 145 genes for which somatic data are informative

This is the primary gene set used to report this check in the manuscript
(Results, Section 3.2): the 145 genes for which somatic data are informative
more broadly (Supplementary Table 2; AUC lower 95% CI > 0.6 for at least one
of COSMIC, sperm, or buccal missense codon count), rather than the narrower
40-gene confident-positive set used above.

```{r overall-145}
overall_145 <- overlap %>% filter(gene %in% genes_145) %>%
  count(class, somatic_status) %>%
  group_by(class) %>% mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  arrange(class, desc(n)) %>% ungroup()
overall_145 %>% knitr::kable(caption = sprintf("The %d genes for which somatic data are informative", length(genes_145)))
write_csv(overall_145, OUT_OVERALL_145)
```

## 5.3 Per-gene results, positive genes

```{r per-gene}
per_gene <- overlap %>% filter(gene %in% genes_positive) %>%
  count(gene, class, somatic_status) %>%
  group_by(gene, class) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1), n_total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()
write_csv(per_gene, OUT_PER_GENE)

per_gene %>% filter(class == "ClinVar P/LP", somatic_status == "Variant of unknown origin") %>%
  select(gene, n_total, n_unknown = n, pct_unknown = pct) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_unknown)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Positive genes with at least one unknown-origin deposition, ranked by percentage (genes not listed had none)")
```

## 5.3b Per-gene results, the 145 informative genes

```{r per-gene-145}
per_gene_145 <- overlap %>% filter(gene %in% genes_145) %>%
  count(gene, class, somatic_status) %>%
  group_by(gene, class) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1), n_total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()
write_csv(per_gene_145, OUT_PER_GENE_145)

per_gene_145 %>% filter(class == "ClinVar P/LP", somatic_status == "Variant of unknown origin") %>%
  select(gene, n_total, n_unknown = n, pct_unknown = pct) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_unknown)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Informative-set genes with at least one unknown-origin deposition, ranked by percentage (genes not listed had none)")
```

## 5.4 Figure

```{r figure, fig.width=11, fig.height=9}
status_colours <- c(
  "Confirmed somatic variant"                    = "#117733",
  "Variant of unknown origin"                    = "#CC6677",
  "Reported in another cancer sample as somatic" = "#88CCEE",
  "Confirmed germline variant"                   = "#332288"
)
present <- unique(overlap$somatic_status)
unmapped <- setdiff(present, names(status_colours))
if (length(unmapped) > 0) {
  cat("Somatic-status categories not in the standard palette (shown in grey):\n  ", paste(unmapped, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  status_colours <- c(status_colours, setNames(rep("#888888", length(unmapped)), unmapped))
}

zero_unknown_genes <- setdiff(unique(per_gene$gene[per_gene$class == "ClinVar P/LP"]),
                               per_gene$gene[per_gene$class == "ClinVar P/LP" & per_gene$somatic_status == "Variant of unknown origin"])
gene_order <- c(zero_unknown_genes,
                per_gene %>% filter(class == "ClinVar P/LP", somatic_status == "Variant of unknown origin") %>%
                  arrange(pct) %>% pull(gene))

fig <- per_gene %>% mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = gene_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gene, y = n, fill = somatic_status)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colours, name = "COSMIC somatic status") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~class, ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "Somatic-status composition of COSMIC depositions of exact ClinVar P/LP\nand biobank-benign variants",
       subtitle = "Somatic-informative (positive) genes, ordered by percentage of unknown-origin depositions (ClinVar P/LP panel)",
       x = NULL, y = "Percentage of COSMIC depositions") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
ggsave(OUT_FIG, fig, width = 11, height = 9, dpi = 300)
fig
```

# 6. Supplementary table

One row per one of the 145 genes for which somatic data are informative
(Supplementary Table 2), giving the ClinVar P/LP and biobank-benign
breakdowns side by side. `auc_lower` is the highest AUC lower 95% confidence
bound across the three somatic features considered for that gene set
(COSMIC, sperm, or buccal missense codon count; count-weighted ClinVar
form), and `qualifying_feature` names which feature achieved it;
`utility_label` carries the monoallelic model's "positive"/"negative"/"grey"
somatic-utility label where available (Section 1) and is `NA` for the 48
genes with a biallelic or X-linked hemizygous inheritance pattern, which
were not part of that (monoallelic-only) model. `n_total` is the total
number of COSMIC depositions of that gene's own reference variants (ClinVar
P/LP or biobank-benign, respectively); `n_unknown` is how many of those are
"Variant of unknown origin"; `pct_unknown` is the corresponding percentage,
left as `NA` where `n_total == 0` rather than reported as a misleading 0%.
`low_n_path`/`low_n_benign` flag genes with fewer than 10 total depositions
in that class, the same threshold used elsewhere in this project to define
benchmarking eligibility, since percentages computed from very few
depositions are unstable. Genes with zero COSMIC evidence in *both* classes
are excluded from the table, as there is nothing to report for them; a gene
with evidence in only one class retains its row. The table is ordered by
`auc_lower` descending, so that genes with the strongest claimed
somatic-data utility are listed first regardless of how much supporting
COSMIC evidence exists for them individually.

```{r supp-table}
supp_base <- overlap %>%
  count(gene, class, somatic_status) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = somatic_status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

status_cols <- setdiff(names(supp_base), c("gene", "class"))

supp_long <- supp_base %>%
  mutate(n_total = rowSums(across(all_of(status_cols))),
         n_unknown = if ("Variant of unknown origin" %in% status_cols) `Variant of unknown origin` else 0L,
         pct_unknown = if_else(n_total > 0, round(100 * n_unknown / n_total, 1), NA_real_)) %>%
  select(gene, class, n_total, n_unknown, pct_unknown)

# For each of the 145 informative genes, the feature (COSMIC/sperm/buccal
# missense codon count) with the highest AUC lower 95% CI, and that CI --
# i.e. whichever feature is responsible for that gene's membership in the
# 145-gene set. Reproduced from Supplementary Table 2, same as Section 1.
informative_auc <- st2 %>%
  filter(gene %in% genes_145, Predictor %in% c("n_COSMIC_codon_count", "n_sperm_codon_count", "n_buccal_codon_count"),
         !is.na(AUC_full_lower)) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  slice_max(AUC_full_lower, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(gene, auc_lower = AUC_full_lower, qualifying_feature = Predictor)

supp_table_all <- tibble(gene = genes_145) %>%
  left_join(informative_auc, by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(gene_universe %>% select(gene, utility_label = label), by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(supp_long %>% filter(class == "ClinVar P/LP") %>% select(-class) %>%
              rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_path"), -gene),
            by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(supp_long %>% filter(class == "Biobank benign") %>% select(-class) %>%
              rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_benign"), -gene),
            by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(across(c(n_total_path, n_unknown_path, n_total_benign, n_unknown_benign), ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)),
         low_n_path = n_total_path < 10, low_n_benign = n_total_benign < 10) %>%
  arrange(desc(auc_lower))

no_evidence_genes <- supp_table_all %>% filter(n_total_path == 0, n_total_benign == 0) %>% pull(gene)
supp_table <- supp_table_all %>% filter(!gene %in% no_evidence_genes)

cat("Genes for which somatic data are informative:", nrow(supp_table_all), "\n")
cat("Excluded (no COSMIC evidence in either class):", length(no_evidence_genes), "-",
    paste(no_evidence_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Rows in supplementary table:", nrow(supp_table), "\n")
cat("Genes with fewer than 10 ClinVar P/LP depositions:", sum(supp_table$low_n_path), "of", nrow(supp_table), "\n")
write_csv(supp_table, OUT_SUPP_TABLE)
supp_table %>% knitr::kable(caption = "The 145 genes for which somatic data are informative: COSMIC somatic-status breakdown for their exact ClinVar P/LP and biobank-benign variants, ordered by AUC lower confidence bound")
```

# Discussion

```{r interp-numbers}
get_pct <- function(tab, cls, status) {
  v <- tab %>% filter(class == cls, somatic_status == status) %>% pull(pct)
  if (length(v) == 0) 0 else v
}
pos_path_unknown   <- get_pct(overall_pos, "ClinVar P/LP", "Variant of unknown origin")
pos_benign_unknown <- get_pct(overall_pos, "Biobank benign", "Variant of unknown origin")
all_path_unknown   <- get_pct(overall, "ClinVar P/LP", "Variant of unknown origin")
all_benign_unknown <- get_pct(overall, "Biobank benign", "Variant of unknown origin")
inf145_path_unknown   <- get_pct(overall_145, "ClinVar P/LP", "Variant of unknown origin")
inf145_benign_unknown <- get_pct(overall_145, "Biobank benign", "Variant of unknown origin")
zero_overlap_pos <- setdiff(genes_positive, unique(overlap$gene))
zero_overlap_145 <- setdiff(genes_145, unique(overlap$gene))
```

Across the `r length(genes_145)` genes for which somatic data are
informative (Supplementary Table 2), **`r inf145_path_unknown`%** of COSMIC
depositions of the exact ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic variants used
as evidence in this project are "Variant of unknown origin". For the exact
biobank-benign variants, the corresponding figure is
**`r inf145_benign_unknown`%**. Restricting to the narrower `r length(genes_positive)`
confident-positive genes (COSMIC missense codon count AUC lower 95% CI >
0.70) gives very similar figures: `r pos_path_unknown`% (ClinVar P/LP) and
`r pos_benign_unknown`% (biobank-benign). Both are well below the
`r all_path_unknown`%/`r all_benign_unknown`% seen across all
`r length(genes_eligible)` monoallelic benchmarking-eligible genes
irrespective of somatic-utility label.

This pooled figure is not evenly distributed across genes; Section 5.3 and
the supplementary table (Section 6) give the per-gene breakdown. A gene's
`n_total` is as informative as its `pct_unknown`, since a percentage
computed from a small number of depositions can be dominated by a single
observation.

`r length(zero_overlap_145)` of the 145 informative genes (`r length(zero_overlap_pos)`
of the 40 confident-positive genes) have no COSMIC deposition of either
their exact ClinVar P/LP or exact biobank-benign variants:
`r if (length(zero_overlap_145) > 0) paste(zero_overlap_145, collapse = ", ") else "none"`.
Absence of a COSMIC deposition for a specific variant does not indicate
absence of somatic recurrence at the underlying locus more broadly, only
that the specific variant used as evidence has not itself been independently
observed in a tumour to date.

A "Variant of unknown origin" annotation represents an upper bound on
potential germline contamination for that deposition, not confirmation of
it: the great majority of such variants are very likely genuinely somatic.
This analysis quantifies exposure to that possibility for the exact evidence
used, rather than estimating a true contamination rate.

This analysis evaluates variant-level COSMIC evidence, comparable to the
`n_COSMIC` feature computed elsewhere in this project, which is distinct
from the codon-aggregated `n_COSMIC_codon_count` feature used to define the
somatic-utility labels themselves (aggregation at codon level is used there
to increase statistical power by pooling independent substitutions at the
same residue). The two should not be conflated when interpreting this
analysis alongside the somatic-utility model.
